note: A paper record of the desk's readings of the engulf on five markets, buys and sells: the engulf rule on D1, H4 and H1 candles, and three zone methods (the plan with the Daily, the short method in an H4 zone, the direct entry on fresh zones) with a 30-pip stop; the plan and the short method have a 2R target, the direct entry none: its stop is trailed with the 5-minute engulf zones that fail. The plan and the short method are recorded twice, apart: with the engulf that may take any number of candles, and with the next-candle engulf only. Nothing is traded, results are before costs, and none is a tested rule.
